chapters.caption: Border block: chamfer, round corner and a 0.1 mm fin
Layer at z 1 mm: borders (red) around the volume hatch (green)
Corner: the first border runs 0.06 mm inside the outline
The fin is only 0.1 mm wide: no room for a compensated border
Instead it gets a blocked path: one line along its middle
First border › Beam compensation: type 0.2 mm
0.2 mm is exaggerated to make the shift visible
After: the border is 0.2 mm inside, the hatch moves with it
Fin: the blocked path now starts further inside the part
Its end also moves back from the tip (0.05 → 0.22 mm)
Toolpaths in 3D up to the current layer
